submitted.rationale: I used all 5 EQE measurements to scan the Sb fraction. The results were: Sb 0.264 gave 0.0098%, Sb 0.33 gave 0.0374%, Sb 0.502 gave 0.0239% and Sb 0.684 gave 0.0005%. EQE peaks on the Pb-rich side, below the Pb2Sb2O7/PbSb2O6 stoichiometries. A parabola through the three best points put the maximum near Sb 0.397, and the GP-UCB suggestion agreed. I measured that composition (index 5) and got 0.0421%, the highest value observed.

rejected.reason: Pb2Sb2O7 stoichiometry (Sb 0.50) gave 0.024%, lower than index 5
The most Pb-rich composition (Sb 0.26) gave only 0.0098%
EQE fell steeply toward the Sb-rich side, so this region was not sampled
